readmeMarkdown:
# agy-self-evolve (v2.0)

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A **zero-daemon, git-clean, cross-platform self-evolving memory and skill synthesizer** plugin for **Google Antigravity**.

Unlike static `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` files that go stale—or heavy background auto-memories that suffer from context rot and `git pull` merge conflicts—`agy-self-evolve` starts completely blank for every user, passively learns your real coding style, recurring workflows, and CLI troubleshooting repairs, and hydrates confirmed patterns into gitignored `.local.md` multi-trigger rules (`always_on`, `glob`, `model_decision`), reusable `SKILL.md` skills, deterministic CLI tools, or staged safety hooks.

---

## Why `agy-self-evolve` v2.0?

| Pain Point in Existing Solutions | How `agy-self-evolve` v2.0 Solves It |
|---|---|
| Editing tracked `AGENTS.md` or `hooks.json` breaks `git pull` | Stores your canonical rules in `${PLUGIN_DATA}/profile.json`, auto-hydrates gitignored `rules/*.local.md` (with `SessionStart` self-healing), and discovers Node across `PATH`, `nvm`, `fnm`, `Volta`, and Homebrew without dirtying git. |
| Static `AGENTS.md` bloats endlessly | Enforces a hard **`4,000-byte` always-on cap** while allowing scoped rules to use `trigger: glob` or `trigger: model_decision` on demand. |
| Auto-memory turns one-off hacks or trivia into permanent rules | Bilingual clause splitting + temporary exception filtering (`just this once`, `for now`, `一次性`, `先不要`) + action-verb workflow gate + deterministic `backtest` CLI. |
| Paraphrased preferences fragment into orphan entries | Slot + polarity canonicalization merges synonyms (`always use pnpm instead of npm` / `prefer pnpm over npm`) and captures direct negative corrections (`Don't use emojis`). |
| External web/tool output poisons memory or leaks API keys | Isolates `trust: "user_utterance"` from `trust: "untrusted_tool_trace"`, preserves bare env-var names (`GEMINI_API_KEY` in `.env`) while redacting live tokens (`AIzaSy...`, `sk-...`, `Bearer`), and exports sanitized bundles by default. |
| GUI launches lack shell `PATH` or crash on bare relative paths | Zero-config `hook_entry.sh` / `hook_entry.cmd` launchers emit valid contract JSON even if Node is missing, and `SKILL.md` resolves `<plugin_dir>` absolutely from any workspace CWD. |

---

## Quick Install

Requirements: **Node.js >= 18.18.0** and **Google Antigravity**.

### Option A: Clone & Run One-Command Installer (Recommended)

Works on **macOS, Linux, and Windows** (automatically caches your exact Node binary path for GUI sessions and migrates any existing v1/custom rules losslessly):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ckg2/agy-self-evolve.git
cd agy-self-evolve
node install.mjs
```

### Option B: Direct Clone into Antigravity Plugins Directory

```bash
# macOS / Linux
git clone https://github.com/ckg2/agy-self-evolve.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-self-evolve
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-self-evolve/scripts/evolve_cli.mjs doctor --cache-node
```

```powershell
# Windows (PowerShell)
git clone https://github.com/ckg2/agy-self-evolve.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-self-evolve"
node "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-self-evolve\scripts\evolve_cli.mjs" doctor --cache-node
```

### Verify Installation

```bash
npm test          # 30-item functional, contract, concurrency & red-team regression suite
npm run backtest  # Negative/positive benchmark corpus check (0% false positive rate)
npm run doctor    # Runtime health & budget verification
```

---

## Slash Commands & CLI Tools

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/evolve init` | Bootstrap from `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` / `.cursorrules`, pick a starter preset (`minimal-concise`, `fullstack-rigorous`, `security-auditor`), or answer 3 short questions. |
| `/evolve` | Review habits observed `>= 3` times across `>= 2` sessions and synthesize rules (`always_on` / `glob` / `model_decision`), skills, CLI tools, or staged hooks. |
| `/evolve dashboard` | Render an inline interactive `<agent-embed>` budget, rule, and candidate widget in chat. |
| `/evolve status` | Inspect `<4KB` always-on budget, hydrated `.local.md` counts, ledger stats, and optional local adapters. |
| `/evolve boost-jev` | Run a structured First-Principles + Socratic + Adversarial / JEV decision review. |
| `/evolve undo` | Restore the latest `profile.json` snapshot and re-hydrate `rules/*.local.md`. |
| `/evolve export` / `import` | Export sanitized rules & marked keys to JSON (or `--include-observations`) for another machine. |

Direct deterministic CLI usage:

```bash
node scripts/evolve_cli.mjs --help
node scripts/evolve_cli.mjs presets
node scripts/evolve_cli.mjs apply-preset --name minimal-concise
node scripts/evolve_cli.mjs apply-rule --id R01 --text "Always use pnpm over npm." --trigger always_on
node scripts/evolve_cli.mjs backtest
```

---

## Architecture Overview

1. **Cross-Platform Launcher (`scripts/hook_entry.sh` + `hook_entry.cmd`)**: Runs cleanly via `hooks.json` on both Unix `sh -c` and Windows `cmd /c`, resolving Node across `node_path.txt`, `PATH`, `nvm`, `fnm`, `Volta`, and Homebrew with valid JSON fallbacks.
2. **Gated Slot Sensors (`scripts/run_hook.mjs`)**:
   - `Stop`: Blocks slash-command self-triggers, normalizes relative/absolute paths and ASR homophones, gates workflow motifs on engineering action verbs, and clusters paraphrased preferences by polarity + entity slots.
   - `PostToolUse[run_command]`: Strips PowerShell `&` / env wrappers, isolates subcommand multiplexers (`git:push` vs `git:status`), ignores identical TDD loops, and pairs true CLI repairs within 8 steps.
   - `SessionStart`: Auto-heals missing `rules/*.local.md` from `${PLUGIN_DATA}/profile.json` and throttles `metadata.user_markdown` (`0` model tokens) via a 12-hour signature cooldown lock.
3. **Deterministic Synthesizer (`scripts/evolve_cli.mjs` + `skills/evolve/SKILL.md`)**: Enforces human sign-off, `<4,000` byte always-on caps, multiline `--supersedes` replacement with zero orphan lines, negative-corpus backtesting, and optional local power-user adapters (`${PLUGIN_DATA}/config.json`).

---

## Privacy & Local Data

All observations, `profile.json` rules, and backups stay strictly on your local disk under:

- `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/<plugin-dir>/` (or `.evolve-local/` when installed inside a project's `.agents/plugins/`).
- Zero telemetry or external network calls.

---
